_comment: Single source of truth for Hashling's wearable items as SVG fragments (+ per-instance gradient ids via {{uid}}). Each group is authored in its own CANONICAL frame, which pets.json maps onto the pet's anatomy for every stage: hat = head frame (origin = crown, x unit ~ 1/100 of the hat span), collar = neck frame (origin = middle of the band), accessory shield = chest frame, solar backpack = shoulder frame (100 units = shoulder span), magnifier = paw frame (origin = grip). Run `python scripts/sync_items.py` after editing to copy into extension/hashling.js.
